message: Contract 'credit.pool_level_pay' declares amortization_day_count = 'act/360'. A level payment is struck once and held; an Actual basis makes it move with month length, because the divisor is period-local and the annuity applies it to every remaining period. Strike the payment on '30/360' or '30e/360' and accrue interest on the Actual basis with `day_count`, which is what an Actual/360 loan document says.
